native_syntax: Primary language carries the story; English lands on emotional peaks or hook pivots.
register: Bilingual pop naturalism — not random word salad
prosody: Switch languages on strong beats / phrase boundaries
rhyme: Rhyme within each language island; cross-language rhyme only if phonetic
punctuation: Keep switches clean; no parenthetical translation of every line
idioms: Do not explain the English phrase in Chinese in the next line

rules: English ratio follows brief.codeSwitching.englishRatio when set
Prefer title/hook for English unless verses placement requested

avoid_patterns: English filler that adds no rhythmic punch
